L_cover_title: THT auto insertion line for your {board_count} boards
L_cover_sub: {line_desc}. Board-by-board cycle, line output and feeder plan, estimated from your PCBA photos.
L_method_title: From your photos to a line plan
L_s1_b: Every through-hole part on each board photo is counted and marked: red circles radial, blue boxes odd-form.
L_s2_h: Match each part to a machine
L_s2_b: Taped radial parts go to the {radial_name}; transformers, connectors, terminals and large parts to the {odd_name}.
L_s3_b: Odd-form parts are split over the {odd_stations} stations by packaging: tube, tray, bulk or tape.
L_s4_b: Cycle per panel = parts ÷ machine rate; the slowest machine paces the line.
L_grp_b_radial: {qty} × {name} · ~{cph} CPH incl. PCB transfer and mark recognition. Inserts all taped radial parts.
L_grp_b_oddform: {qty} × {name} · {stations} · ~{cph} CPH each (0.9 s per part average). Inserts transformers, connectors, terminals and large parts.
L_sum_title: {rate_min} – {rate_max} boards an hour across the four boards
L_sum_title_n: {rate_min} – {rate_max} boards an hour across the boards
L_sum_note: Line output = 3,600 s ÷ slowest machine cycle × boards per panel (theoretical). At {eff_pct} % line efficiency: {plan_min} – {plan_max} boards / h.
L_b_title: {id}: {line_boards_h} boards an hour, paced by the {bottleneck}
L_b_text: {bpp} boards per panel; {parts_list} per board. Red circles: radial, blue boxes: odd-form. Cycle includes PCB in/out and mark recognition.
L_feed_note: Feeder types follow the packaging seen on the photos; confirm with the customer BOM before the plan is frozen.
L_bal_title: The {bott_main} paces the line on every board
L_bal_title_mixed: Where the line waits, board by board
L_bal_note: Concept view: adding one machine on the bottleneck group, other machines unchanged. Confirmed in the line layout and quotation.
L_ready_title: What the parts need for automatic insertion
L_ready: Radial parts on tape (reel or ammo), body height ≤ 20 mm, diameter ≤ 10 mm, spans 2.5 / 5.0 / 7.5 / 10.0 mm.
Tape pull-out force when unwinding ≤ 5 N (17.9 oz); tape and lead dimensions per the radial tape standard.
Odd-form parts in tube, tray, bulk or tape packaging, one packaging type per feeder.
Heavy or large parts (transformers, large connectors) take 0.9 – 1.3 s each; included in the estimate.
L_a_eff: Theoretical output; planning uses {eff_pct} % line efficiency, {shift_h} h shifts and {days} working days a month.
L_n1_b: Send sample panels and parts; we run them on the {radial_name} and {odd_name} and return a timed video and report.
L_n2_b: Floor layout with conveyors, feeder carts and operator positions for your plant.
L_n3_b: Formal quotation for the line with feeders, programming, installation and training.
